title: Treating the $1,500 as USD
headline: The $1,500 is USD and covers travel and beds
summary: The trip is in the US, so I priced in dollars. That's about $2,050 CAD of room.
detail: You didn't say which currency. Most of what I'm booking is priced in USD, so I've read the budget as $1,500 USD, roughly $2,050 CAD. Food isn't included.

title: Five nights in New York, three in Boston
headline: Five nights in New York, three in Boston
summary: New York has more to see. Boston prices spike on the last weekend anyway.
detail: I leaned toward New York: more to do, and Boston gets expensive Oct 16–18 for the regatta. Oct 10–15 New York, Oct 15–18 Boston.

title: Checked flights and trains to New York for Oct 10
headline: Compared 18 ways to New York
detail: Flights from Pearson and Billy Bishop, and the Maple Leaf train (12 hours, not worth it).

title: Held Porter PD 2113, 6:50 AM Billy Bishop to Newark
headline: Porter to Newark, Saturday 6:50 AM
summary: Cheapest refundable fare with a window seat.
detail: Cheapest refundable fare. Seat 12A. 24-hour free cancellation.

title: New York: hostel or a small hotel room
headline: A hostel bed, or a tiny private room for twice the price
summary: The hostel is the value pick. Pod 39 is the cheapest private room I'd stay in.
detail: I'd take the hostel. If you want your own room, Pod 39 is the least bad private option in Manhattan that week.

title: Booked FlixBus New York to Boston, Wed 9:30 AM
headline: FlixBus to Boston, Wednesday 9:30 AM
summary: Half the price of the train, and only an hour slower.
detail: FlixBus from Port Authority is $25 USD against $49 for Amtrak. It's non-refundable, but at that price I took it.

title: Boston hostels nearly full for Oct 16-18
headline: Boston is almost booked up for the regatta
summary: Two hostels left under $120 a night. I'm watching them.
detail: Head of the Charles is Oct 17–18. Most hostels are full; HI Boston and one other still have beds.

title: Searched return flights for Oct 11 instead of Oct 18
headline: Searched the wrong day for the flight home
summary: I priced October 11 for twenty minutes before catching it. Redone for the 18th.
detail: Typo in my search. Every return price before 3:30 AM was for Oct 11. I threw those out and redid the search for Oct 18.

title: Flight home: layover or direct
headline: A short layover through JFK beats both extremes
summary: Delta via JFK has a 2h 45m connection for $256. It sits between the cheap long layover and the direct.
detail: The cheapest fare is American through Philadelphia, but that's a 6-hour wait. Delta through JFK is $58 more with a normal connection. Direct is $150 more again.

title: Done
headline: Done for the night
summary: Two things booked, two questions for you.
detail: 137 searches. Booked the Porter flight and the bus to Boston. New York bed and the flight home are waiting on you.
